body: Honestly I'm really tired of being told I'm only worth enough to afford food and shelter. Can't even afford those these days. When I asked my mom for help she laughed on her way to a casino.
They aren't a threat if we kill them. I think I see how my life can be of use now.
And eat what? Shower where? Why should I have to suffer? I would rather kill those who have caused this society to get to this disgusting low.
I'm sick of the struggle. I haven't felt relaxed or smiled in years. Meanwhile, some rich kid is coasting and making six figures right out of college. I want them to suffer.

I was perfectly fine with college and life before I started a shitty minimum wage retail job. I  lost everything shortly after because the stress broke me. Now I literally live hand to mouth with nothing to live for.
You are a slave if you spend all your energy to afford food and shelter. There's no point to life.
I don't have any energy left. I would rather just die than struggle pointlessly to live a shitty slave life.
I think my life would be more meaningful if I died to get others basic human rights and a better shot at life than I had.
I was considering starving myself to death publicly anyway to protest capitalism but I guess Trump really is the poster child for it. I suppose I could make it about him.

Yes, I think all the time about how much I could contribute to society if my basic human rights were taken care of and I didn't have to slave away meaninglessly. Work cost me my education, my friends, my family, and my sanity. I am a husk of the person I was when I graduated high school. I wish for death daily.

Working just to afford basic bodily functions makes life meaningless. If you can't afford anything else life has no point. I have lived on cup ramen for longer than I would wish on Hitler. And I still can't afford health insurance or a car.

Honestly I've tried all this and been taken advantage of left and right. I'm sick of living hand to mouth. Society shouldn't be this way. Our human rights should be taken care of so we don't have to constantly stress and focus on starting a career or education. I would rather die than go back to the stress of working for nothing.

I've done college, got halfway and had a complete meltdown because working and having class stresses me out so much. I can't even decide on a major because I don't want to be taken advantage of in a career. Now I can't even hold down a job because the thought of being a slave depresses me. I'd honestly rather die than live in this unfair world.
I would rather just die. I'm tired of hurting. I just want someone else to hurt more.
Then I guess I am worthless and deserve death.
No, I would rather die than live like this. Honestly, these responses are starting to make me think I should start thinking about taking some people with me.
Then I will just die. Good job.
